title: 28 rulings filed since 20:00 CST Nov 14 lack both supersedes and supersedes_none
why:
02:58 CST Nov 15 (coordinator, data) UPDATE: no longer held; LOW priority. The lane for PR 3488 (owner-accepts-held-negative) read the code, not a run on the live store: the lift reads only the one cited ruling (merge/merge.py:4952-4955 checks that entry alone; lint/ruled_store.py:131-144 skips a bad file by itself; only an unreadable store holds, with a fetch remedy), so the 28 do not block the lift. The lift reads the lane's last-fetched origin/roadmap (no fetch), so a fresh ruling needs a fetch first. Triage has not read that code.

02:57 CST Nov 15 (coordinator, data; superseded by the update above): was HELD until the lane for PR 3488 answered whether a bad entry elsewhere breaks the lift for another ruling. Found at 02:5x CST (triage fork, read-only run of check_entry from lint/ruled_store.py against the roadmap checkout): ruling own-3381-a failed check_entry for lacking supersedes and supersedes_none; fixed in commit 4a8b71bdf. The same fork found the 28 other rulings filed since 20:00 CST Nov 14 also lack both fields (own-draft-rebase-lanes, own-round1-branch-a, own-never-idle-order-ranks, own-spawn-model-below-role-pick, own-tiny-fixes-b, own-no-receipt-for-chat-answer, own-export-receipts-list-a, own-2817-summary-tail-pick, own-2917-merge-main-pick, own-2932-scope-pick, own-lint-skip-green-rollup-a and others). It fixed none: each needs a read of whether it supersedes an earlier ruling (for example own-no-receipt-for-chat-answer replaces the consultant's withdrawn 02:44 and 02:45 rulings; own-2917-merge-main-pick was replaced by own-round1-branch-a). Cause: triage's filing forks did not know the shape of a ruling entry (building-mistake-names-its-guard: the guard is this step plus a line in triage's filing brief template: 'every ruling entry carries supersedes or supersedes_none'). Cost: none measured. Counts disagree: the fork's read-only run found 275 of 377 rulings store-wide lacking both fields (28 of them filed since 20:00 CST Nov 14); the coordinator relayed that 272 of 374 entries HAVE one. Triage has not measured which is right.
source: Coordinator message 02:57 CST Nov 15; triage fork read-only check at 02:5x CST (commit 4a8b71bdf for own-3381-a).
note: Low priority, not held (02:58 CST). A lane (or triage) settles each of the 28: supersedes <id> where it replaces a ruling, supersedes_none where it replaces nothing. Do not guess. Check with check_entry through verdict after each batch.
